rule: Every resolved place remains selectable with its canonical score; only independently worthwhile settlements scoring 60 or more appear as town markers.
namingDecisions: Monboddo House is retained as an estate, not used to inflate Auchenblae.
Mondynes is the wider recognised locality.
Parkneuk resolves to the Arbuthnott-area hamlet.
Scotston resolves to the Laurencekirk locality.
Redford resolves to Redford Farm near Garvock and remains separate from Redford near Carmyllie.
Tulloch represents the Nether and Easter Tulloch cluster.

additions.name: Auchenblae
additions.rationale: Auchenblae has a coherent village identity and local services, but remains below the map gate until a full visitor audit verifies its complete offer.

additions.name: Monboddo House
additions.rationale: Monboddo House is retained as a heritage estate reference. Its historical importance is not treated as public access and does not inflate Auchenblae.

additions.name: Mondynes
additions.rationale: Mondynes is the wider named locality around its farms, bridge and traditional King Duncan association, without a destination-scale visitor offer.

additions.name: Brownmuir
additions.rationale: Brownmuir is retained separately from Fordoun and the former airfield records; neither nearby history nor housing development makes it a tourist settlement.

additions.name: Fordoun
additions.rationale: Fordoun has genuine village character and services, but remains below 60 pending a full destination audit and does not inherit nearby estate value.

additions.name: Parkneuk
additions.rationale: This resolves to Parkneuk beside Arbuthnott, distinct from the Glendavan place of the same name.

additions.name: Arbuthnott
additions.rationale: Arbuthnott has a distinct historic village identity, while private estate and church heritage remain independently assessed.

additions.name: Scotston
additions.rationale: This resolves to Scotston near Laurencekirk, not Scotston of Kirkside or the Aberdeen locality.

additions.name: Garvock
additions.rationale: Garvock has a distinct church-and-hamlet identity but insufficient verified visitor infrastructure for a town marker.

additions.name: Redford
additions.rationale: This is the Redford Farm locality near Garvock, retained separately from Redford near Carmyllie.

additions.name: Tulloch
additions.rationale: Tulloch represents the Garvock-area Nether and Easter Tulloch cluster rather than inventing separate tourist settlements for each farm.
